comparison.objective: Mount a filled malt cup around a fixed mixer spindle so its rim seats in the guide and activates the motor; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tilt-and-lift insertion around a spindle, precise seating on a stepped rest, and spill avoidance versus fine tool insertion, lock manipulation, collar rotation, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cup must seat on the run step, lift the switch pin, contain the spindle, remain upright, released, and still; excessive tilt or falling fails. Candidate uses axial impact, force, rebound, and setting-drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Constrained vessel mounting and switch engagement do not test adjustment locking or response-based commissioning.
